faqs.a:
Section AM101.1 General,
is hereby amended to include an additional subsection as follows:
"
AM101.1.1. Fire sprinkler systems.
A fire sprinkler system in accordance with Section R313 shall be installed when the
                  home day care is licensed by the State of Colorado for the custodial care of more
                  than 8 occupants."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
